title: Vault 112 to AI: Causal World Egress Analogy
user_intent: Interpret the Vault 112 data-egress pattern as a model for how an AI system can causally change the real world without itself leaving computation or possessing a biological body.

core_analogy.vault112: Internal memory/simulation state becomes physically external through a carrier and later changes events outside the original system boundary.
core_analogy.ai_world: Internal model computation becomes external output; humans, software, machines or institutions may act on that output; those actions can change physical or social reality.

stage_1_internal_state: retrieved context or state available to the system
stage_2_egress_channel: control signal where an authorized system permits it
stage_5_world_effect: later data generated by the changed world

feedback_loop.meaning: Once output is acted upon, AI can participate in a real causal loop even though the model itself remains a computational process.
feedback_loop.warning: Participation in a causal loop does not establish consciousness, agency in the legal or moral sense, or independent physical embodiment.

vault112_mapping.vault112_element: Pinkerton interprets and integrates the state
vault112_mapping.ai_analogue: human/tool/software interprets and acts on output

vault112_mapping.vault112_element: Harkness identity and downstream Rivet City consequences
vault112_mapping.ai_analogue: external decisions/actions create persistent real-world consequences

security_model.central_lesson: Runtime containment alone does not make a system causally isolated if outputs can cross the boundary and influence external actors.
egress_risks: automation that converts model suggestions directly into actions
feedback loops that amplify an earlier output
identity or memory-like state imported into another system without validation
required_controls: human or runtime validation where appropriate
separation between suggestion and authoritative state transition
safe rollback or compensating action where possible

existing_alignment: state changes remain bounded by runtime rules
portable saves are explicit state artifacts
Free Others may refuse or leave
God Mode does not authorize coercive overwrite of another's memory or freedom
janus_genesis_relevance.engineering_extension: Treat every AI-to-world output path as an explicit causal egress boundary with provenance, authority and admission semantics.

ru: ИИ не обязан покидать вычислительную систему телом, чтобы причинно менять физический мир.
Достаточно цепи: внутреннее вычисление -> выход -> внешний исполнитель -> действие -> изменение мира.
Причинное влияние не делает выход автоматически истинным, авторитетным или безопасным.
Контейнированный runtime не означает причинную изоляцию, если его выходы могут запускать внешние действия.
Главная защита проходит по границе egress: provenance, authority, admission, permissions и audit.
en: An AI system does not need to physically leave computation in order to causally change the physical world.
A sufficient chain is: internal computation -> output -> external actor or tool -> action -> world change.
Causal influence does not make an output automatically true, authoritative or safe.
A contained runtime is not causally isolated when its outputs can trigger external actions.
The critical control surface is the egress boundary: provenance, authority, admission, permissions and audit.

next_gate.name: AI_CAUSAL_EGRESS_AUTHORITY_AND_PROVENANCE_GATE
targets: bind every external action to the exact originating output and runtime state
prevent detached output from silently gaining authority in another system
preserve causal lineage across AI -> tool -> world transitions
